actors.name: Courier Ansel Kerr
actors.speaker: ansel
actors.team_note: hardy haulers from somewhere else; both species have no authored wild home
actors.before: Mind the cart. The medicine is spoken for.
intro: Wheel's gone, and the medicine has a delivery window. If you have a free hand, hold the cart steady.
We came out of a place that was ending. Nobody here asked us for anything but a bed, and I try to say thank you with work.
Tell me something. Are this world's trainers any good? Show me. Practice only, nobody gets hurt.
actors.ask: Ansel rolls his shoulders and thumbs a Poke Ball.
actors.over_cap: That one is too strong for a practice match. Leave it in the box and I will take you on.
after: Good. That is what I wanted to see: a world that fights fair. The lake office will hear the cart is a day late.
Go on to the lake. Nia is working the landing, and she will not turn anyone away.
actors.placeholder: Claude, 2026-10-11 (unit CP-ROUTES): stand-in lines for Codex. Each does its beat: the first sight of the Compact as people, nothing said about method (docs/story/HAVEN_COMPACT_PASS.md CP-01)

actors.name: Mila Aster
actors.speaker: mila
actors.before: Please do not lean on the cart.
lines: Do not mind Ansel. He has been waiting a week to meet someone who is not a clerk.
My husband Dev and our son Jo are by the wheel. Jo has decided your Pokemon are his now.
We were evacuated once already, before this. Nia carried us out herself. The Compact kept that promise, so we are keeping ours: we go where the next boat goes.
Whatever you hear about the Compact on this road, I hope you remember the cart.
actors.repeat: Lake Viltri is a day's walk. Nia is on the landing. Tell her the Asters are well.

lines: You are the one who came down from Brock's valley. Sit. Let me look at that hand.

The boats come in at night now. Crews unload, families sleep in rows on the promenade, and by morning the lake office has another page of names.
People call what we do rescue, and some call it theft. I have stopped arguing the word. I count the people.

actors.name: Cirque Ranger Teo Halloran
actors.speaker: teo
actors.team_note: mountain natives, Rock and Ice; NOT homeless species on purpose (he is local)
actors.before: The cirque is closed to survey crews until the herders say otherwise.
intro: The Compact's survey calls this cirque empty volume. I have summered sheep here nineteen years, and my children were born in that hut.
Marn is not cruel. Her map is just wrong, and nobody has asked the herders.
actors.side_ask: Will you stand with the herders?
actors.side_thanks: Then lift her stakes, gently. She will want a fight for it. Do not hurt her. She is only wrong.
fight_intro: So you stand with the survey. A map with a stake in my grazing, and you would hold it.
Then show me the survey can stand.
actors.ask: Teo whistles his dogs back and squares up.
actors.over_cap: Not with that one. Put it in the box and I will fight you fair.
after: Then her map stands. Read it first, though: it still counts nobody who lives in the huts below.
actors.sided_after: The surveyor has the herders' names now. Whatever else she is, she writes them down.
actors.placeholder: Claude, 2026-10-11 (unit CP-ROUTES): stand-in lines for Codex

actors.name: Destination Surveyor Ilse Marn
actors.speaker: ilse
actors.team_note: instruments that sense: Psychic and Steel; all three have no authored wild home
actors.before: Survey in progress. Please keep clear of the stakes.
intro: Destination survey for the Merian cirque. Flat, dry, no structures on my instruments. By any measure I own, nobody lives here.
The ranger disagrees. I have not found what he is pointing at.
actors.side_ask: Will you stand with the survey?
actors.side_thanks: Then the ranger will not let it stand quietly. He will want a fight for his stakes. Be fair to him.
fight_intro: You stand with the herders. The stakes are mine, and the crew is waiting on this reading.
If the map is wrong I will redraw it. Convince me with something other than a speech.
actors.ask: Ilse sets her instruments down, carefully, and takes out a Poke Ball.
actors.over_cap: I will not fight that one. Put it away; the instruments are fragile.
after: Four herder families, thirty-one children, none on my sheet. I will redraw it. Tell Nia I need her people to confirm the names.
actors.sided_after: The ranger has gone quiet. The map will be redrawn, but not today.
actors.placeholder: Claude, 2026-10-11 (unit CP-ROUTES): stand-in lines for Codex. The surveyor's after-line is Tomas's discipline at small scale: a better map, not a speech
